outputs.explanation: The lower graph in panel A is a bar chart of HMGB1 signal intensity (Nuc/Cyto) shown as mean ± SD across N=4 mice, n>100 cells, but only bars with error bars are shown; no individual data points (e.g., dots for cells/mice) are overlaid.
The lower graph quantifying % aggregate-positive Purkinje cells is a bar chart with mean ± SD (N=4, n>400), but no individual data points are overlaid on the bars.
Panel C is a western blot image with no accompanying quantification plot, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.
Panel D is a line plot (rotarod time vs. week) with error bars for each genotype; line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement since overlaying points would make them unreadable.
Panel E consists of line plots (rotarod time across days 1-3 at three ages) with error bars; line plots are exempt from this check.
Panel F is a Kaplan-Meier survival curve, a line-plot type presentation of survival data; such plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel G shows only immunofluorescence micrographs (Calbindin, DAPI, Merge) with no quantification plot, so the check does not apply.

Both graphs in panel H (molecular layer thickness and Purkinje cell number) are bar charts showing mean ± SD across N=3 mice / n=9 measurements, but individual data points are not overlaid on the bars.
